items.item: F07 command surface: the task commands are registered, the writes are marked mutating, and publication without a configured forge is refused rather than simulated
tests: the task commands are registered, the writes are marked mutating, and publication without a forge is refused

items.item: F07 deletion: deleting a repository purges its tasks, event log, plans, candidates, verdicts, grants and publication rows
tests: deleting a repository takes its tasks, events, candidates, verdicts and publication rows with it

items.item: F07 gh transport failure vocabulary: rate limit, expired credential and refusal map to connector states
tests: a rate limit, an expired credential and a refusal map to their connector states

items.item: F07-D3 isolation audit escape suite (network, host file read, fork bomb, env read, long sleep) — not implemented; candidate runs use Node's permission model and say so
items.needs: WP-02: a container or VM-backed isolation profile with an escape-test suite, so candidates can run behind a real boundary instead of the local permission model whose omissions are disclosed on every run

items.item: F07-D11/D12 flaky-outcome reporting and keyboard-only task flow — the outcome list is retained but no flaky fixture or keyboard test exists yet
items.needs: a flaky fixture repository and a keyboard-only browser test for the task panel (create, confirm, review, approve, publish)

items.item: F07-D6 branch allowlist and WP-08 model proposer: the egress boundary (consent, preview, secret scrubbing, audit-by-hash) is implemented and tested, but no command calls a model to produce edit operations yet, and the branch-prefix allowlist is enforced in the publisher without its own test
items.needs: a `C15/proposeEdits` command that calls the configured provider through the existing egress gate and returns edit operations, plus a branch-prefix test that asserts a non-`cie/` name is refused at the publisher
